Now, he explains, this jagrat, Sopan and Sushakti in three sutras.
Jhanam jagrat, external organic knowledge is jagrat, external organic knowledge.
It is not knowledge of self. Jhanam means organic knowledge, dualistic knowledge.
Sopna vikalpa, internal perceptions and thoughts are sopna.
Vikalpa means perceptions, internal perceptions.
If internal perceptions are found in wakefulness also, that is also sopna.
Avi veko maya saushaktam, forgetfulness and negation of awareness is maya or sushakti.
Sardarana, Arthavishyam, Bhai, Indraism, Jhanam, Lokasi jagrat, Jagravastha.
